text:
yuki: New hire ran through the quickstart and hit a reproducible hang during pagination when using the Go sample. Seems like client-side throttling + large page size stalls the stream.

ram: Can you share how many parallel fetches and SDK version? Go SDK had a different token semantics last release.

yuki: Running sample with --parallel=10 --page=500, go-sdk v0.6.4 bundled. After a burst of 429s, it backs off and then nothing emits for ~40s.

elaine: That sounds like the token-bucket in Go v0.6 used integer tokens per byte vs per-request, so high page sizes consume many tokens. We changed that in v0.7 to count per-request and added a small burst window.

ram: Logs?

yuki: Truncated logs:

```
[2026-03-25T11:02:01Z] INFO paginator: start page=2
[2026-03-25T11:02:01Z] WARN api: 429 x-retry-after=3
[2026-03-25T11:02:01Z] INFO throttle: tokens_left=0
[2026-03-25T11:02:04Z] INFO retry: sleeping 3000ms attempt=1
[2026-03-25T11:02:06Z] INFO throttle: reclaimed=1
[2026-03-25T11:02:46Z] INFO paginator: no worker scheduled
```

yuki: Note reclaimed=1 then long idle. Looks like all workers were competing for a large token slice and then starved.

elaine: Confirmed. Fix options: 1) bump Go SDK in sample to >=0.7 which treats tokens per-request and adds jitter, 2) reduce default pageSize in Go sample to 100, or 3) change ThrottleConfig to allow small bursts (burst=5).

ram: For parity, we should also add a note in the README: "Go SDK v0.6 token accounting differs from v0.7+; if you see long pauses, upgrade or lower page size." New hires keep thinking it's an API outage.

go-sdk-bot: Created ticket G-221: "go-samples: paginator stalls due to token accounting; update sample defaults and docs" https://redwood/tickets/G-221

yuki: I'll open a tiny PR to: update go.mod to require go-sdk v0.7.1, change --page default to 100, and add REDWOOD_PAGINATOR_CONCURRENCY env var with default 3 in sample.

elaine: Also add a quick snippet in README showing a ThrottleConfig example for dev vs prod, e.g. "dev: {maxTokens:8,refillMs:200,burst:2}, prod: {maxTokens:64,refillMs:100,burst:8}" and explain reasoning.

ram: Good. One extra ask: add a small repro script that simulates restart bursts so onboarding can run it locally. That helps PMs triage.

yuki: PR opened: https://redwood/pr/812 includes sample changes, README note, and repro script. Asking for review from @elaine and @ram.

devex-bot: Linked ticket G-221 to PR 812 and added label "onboarding"

elaine: Thanks. Once merged, we'll push updated sample images and add a line to the onboarding checklist.

yuki: cheers, will follow up with a short playbook entry for client-side throttle troubleshooting.
